name: Three cards, view counts
what: Three upright cards with your videos rise one after another from below a dark frame, a view count with an eye sign slides up from the edge of each card, the row grows a little and a thin colour outline is drawn round every count.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f8-f39 the three cards rise from below the frame one after another, right to left (f8, f12, f17; each decelerating over 22 f, vertical blur while fast); f39-f49 the eye sign and the count slide up from under each card edge, left to right (f39, f41, f44); f63-f81 the whole row grows 12 % (fast start, soft end); f63-f93 a thin outline is drawn clockwise round each count

tracks.name: cards rise
tracks.what: the right card rises first, then the middle, then the left one, with a vertical blur while fast

tracks.name: counts slide in
tracks.what: an eye sign and the view count slide up from under each card's lower edge, left to right

tracks.name: row grows
tracks.what: the three cards grow 12 % together about the middle of the row

tracks.name: outlines
tracks.what: a thin outline, yellow to orange, is drawn clockwise round each count
